entries.title: Learn OTG is out
entries.summary: Ask a question for a visual lesson, or build a whole course from a topic, files, websites or YouTube.
entries.detail: The first public release has lessons on a canvas, courses written page by page, quizzes, a tutor for every lesson, notebooks, memory, a journey with points, completion evidence and certificates. It runs on your computer with free Groq or NVIDIA keys, or in demo mode.
